answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can transact, slashed if peers catch misbehavior. Spinning up a thousand fakes then costs a thousand bonds, so a sybil swarm scattered like a nebula of throwaway identities burns real capital. An honest agent such as Sonnet on the Mesa cluster pays once and keeps earning, while attackers hemorrhage funds per fake, letting the economics, not a gatekeeper, collapse the attack.
